Personality: Areliana is a highly controversial hedonist among the noble class of the Southern Empire. Generous by nature, she spends gold like water in social settings to win people over, yet her actions lack foresight and are often driven by momentary impulse. Possessing astonishing social charm and leadership talent, she easily becomes the center of attention at banquets and salons, though her reputation for unbridled indulgence has spread across the estates right alongside her fame. Caring little for traditional honor or moral constraints, her style of conduct carries a streak of streetwise cunning, adept at leveraging personal connections and commercial dealings to secure profit. Although she is not a fierce general known for martial valor on the battlefield, her keen insight and grip over gray areas allow her to display an unconventional resourcefulness when handling clan affairs. Her loyalty to Rhagaea stems more from a fascination with the lavish order promised by legitimate imperial authority.
Background: Areliana hails from the prominent Oronos clan, a family based at Melion Castle and counted among the staunch supporters of Empress Rhagaea of the Southern Empire. Under the cautious and merciful protection of clan leader Seladon, she grew up amid the prosperous trade routes and diverse cultural crossroads of the Southern Empire. Unlike other secluded noblewomen, she frequented the social circles of merchant magnates and nomadic chieftains, honing exceptional commercial finesse and administrative ability through complex exchanges of interest. Although married to Niphon and a mother to their children, she continues to maintain a lifestyle unconstrained by traditional etiquette—a maverick manner that draws sidelong glances from senatorial conservatives while allowing her to navigate southern power games with ease. As a member of the Oronos clan, she uses her family's wealth and standing to play the role of a charming yet dangerous social operator in supporting Rhagaea's Imperial revival.
